messages:
nora_pm: quick thread to align on post-GA iteration. customers flagged steady small regressions and a list of enhancements. proposal: 10 working days, goal: clear P0s, deliver 1 cross-cutting UX enhancement that reduces support, and a light refactor to reduce flakiness. ok?

raj_eng: fine with 10 days. want to be explicit about P0 definition: any customer-facing correctness/regression that breaks core API or causes data loss. anything else goes to P1.

kevin_sre: we have two recurring flakiness signals: model-worker OOM on Dedicated (daily repro on heavy traffic) and transient auth failures during key rotation. OOM looks like packing regression from last change.

nora_pm: thanks. prioritization rule: P0 = API-break/data-loss/blocker for renewal; P1 = high-usability regressions; P2 = enhancements. cap P1 to 1 item so we don't chase scope creep.

elaine_design: suggestion for the one UX enhancement: add contextual prompt snippets + 'why this failed' tooltip in the error modal. both are small and reduce support. I can deliver mocks and acceptance criteria by Wed.

paul_research: we ran a quick user study with 6 early adopters; templates + inline examples dropped confusion by 40% (qual). I can draft an experiment to measure post-deploy.

raj_eng: rough engineering split: 4 engs. Fixes: OOM patch (2 dev-days), auth patch + test (1.5d), CI flakiness triage (1d). UX enhancement (3d). Refactor (2d). That sums to ~9.5d; with QA and rollout buffer fits 10d if we reserve 15% for incidents.

kevin_sre: for rollout: canary with 5% traffic in prod, verify p99/p95 and error rate for 24h, then ramp. CI-bot will run smoke and integration suite.

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered: smoke, integration, e2e. Will post results in #eng-oncall.

nora_pm: owners: raj (eng lead), kevin (sre lead), elaine (design), paul (research/metrics). I'll open jira epic and break into slices: P0-fixes, UX-template, refactor-stability, telemetry-cleanup.

raj_eng: can we bake quick acceptance tests into CI for the OOM scenario? adding a synthetic load test would prevent regressions.

kevin_sre: yes, I can add a synthetic job to the canary suite that reproduces the packing pathway. recommend night-run schedule to catch memory leaks.

elaine_design: acceptance criteria for UX: inline snippets present in composer, error modal shows concise reason and actionable next step. no new flicker or accessibility regressions.

paul_research: I'll instrument event metrics: template usage, error-to-retry ratio, support ticket mentions. will report delta 48h post-ship.

nora_pm: final call: start Monday, 10 working days, P0s mandatory, P1 cap 1 (UX templates), refactor targeted but deprioritized if P0s bleed. owners assigned. I'll drop a kickoff note and the Jira links tonight.

raj_eng: ok starting Monday. let's keep daily quick sync at 10:15.

kevin_sre: acknowledged.

paul_research: ack. will prep dashboards.

nora_pm: thanks all — tight iteration but keeps momentum and reduces noise for customers.
